These gradient fixtures are original Wyreup test inputs under the repository MIT
license. No competitor assets, rendered samples or code are copied. Actual
textDeveloperTools provides the CSS gradient module. Alpha, angle, stop and
explicit picker expected CSS strings are fixed independent literal oracles.
Delayed wrappers compute actual module output and control only transport timing
or a labelled artificial transport error for lifecycle tests. The default
registry remains intentionally unregistered. Resource-syntax tests never fetch
remote content. Browser tests reopen full CSS and actual JSON downloads, preserve
advanced source text, exercise desktop/375px displays and save preview screenshots.
Human, production and npm acceptance are separate.
